name: GearTranslations Translator
description: A GearTranslations translator plugin for TMGMT.
project_description:
GearTranslations translator plugin for the Translation Management Tools (TMGMT) project, used to programatically internationalize your Drupal content.

 Back to top 

 Features 
 
 Drupal 8 ready 
 Translate from and to more than 40 languages 
 Select your translation level (Web, Expert, Premium...) 
 Pay for your content once! Using our Translation Library, already translated content will not appear in your invoice! 
 
 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 
 Depends on Translation Management Tools 
 Requires a registered account on GearTranslations translation platform . Contact drupal@geartranslations.com for more information 
 
 Back to top 

 Maintenance 
 This is the official integration module for GearTranslations, maintained by GEAR TRANSLATION SL.
